title: Identify network port by blinking LEDs
summary: Make the LEDs on a network interface blink to help physically identify which port or cable corresponds to a specific interface.

steps.explain: Blink the LEDs on the specified interface for a given number of seconds.

placeholders.name: INTERFACE
placeholders.description: The name of your network interface.

placeholders.name: SECONDS
placeholders.description: Duration in seconds to blink the LEDs.
